description: The data of a state.recovered event: the server is up again, a use is back at or under its limit, or a service runs again.

key.description: reachable, cpu.used_pct, mem.used_pct, disk[<mount>].used_pct, or unit[<service>].failed.

old.description: The value before. reachable and unit[...].failed are 1 or 0.

threshold.description: The limit that the value went past (state.changed) or came back from (state.recovered).
